about_section_title: Residential Center for Persons with Disabilities from Hâncești municipality
about_text_1: The Residential Center for Persons with Disabilities from Hâncești municipality is an institution founded in 1963, with the mission to support people in vulnerable situations. Here, each beneficiary receives not only protection and care, but also a warm atmosphere, close to the spirit of a family. Currently, 240 people aged between 10 and 60 are placed in the center, with a total capacity of 315 places, which allows for personalized services and individual attention to each person.
about_text_2: During placement, beneficiaries enjoy family-type living conditions adapted to their needs, medical and social rehabilitation for autonomy development, as well as educational and occupational activities that prepare them for independent living. At the same time, the center provides support for community integration, promoting respect for each person's dignity.
about_text_3: We are proud of numerous successful integrations into society. We have beneficiaries who have started families, such as a young woman who got married and formed her own family. Others have returned to biological families or been supported through APP-type services and community homes. At the same time, many of our beneficiaries have found employment and lead active and independent lives today, demonstrating that people with disabilities can live with dignity and be an integral part of the community, without barriers and differences.

faq_what_is_CPTPD_q: What is the Residential Center for Persons with Disabilities?
faq_what_is_CPTPD_a: The Residential Center for Persons with Disabilities from Hâncești municipality is a public social assistance institution that provides specialized services for persons with disabilities aged 10-60 who are in risk situations or have special needs. The center operates under the Agency for Social Services and Inclusion and has the mission of protecting, caring for and rehabilitating vulnerable persons.
faq_what_services_q: What services does the center offer?
faq_what_services_a: The center offers multiple specialized services: Crisis and Family Reintegration Section for persons in emergency situations, Maternal Section for mothers and children in difficulty, Day Section for persons with neuro-motor disabilities, Respite Section for families with persons with special needs, Psycho-pedagogical Assistance Section, Rehabilitation Section and Medical Assistance Section.
faq_how_to_apply_q: How can I request the center's services?
faq_how_to_apply_a: To request the center's services, you must contact the Child Protection Directorate from Hâncești municipality or the local guardianship and trusteeship authorities. They will evaluate the situation and issue, if applicable, a placement order. You can also contact the center directly at phone number 022 737 027 for consultations.
faq_emergency_contact_q: What number can I call in case of emergency?
faq_emergency_contact_a: In case of emergency, you can call phone number 022 737 027, which operates 24/7. The center has a non-stop operating regime for crisis situations. You can also contact the Emergency Service for Child Protection or competent local authorities.
